ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat 20 Oct 2026: release Mini Verb 0.2.3-experimental without hardware testing, with the same waivers as 0.2.2.
reason: The owner approved this exact native source: 0.2.2 with the ring wrapped at 15,870 words so it never writes Sidechain Compressor's key window on T3 and T7, output bit-identical to published 0.2.2 in verify.py's 76 checks, guarded renders without a stray write and a control that catches 0.2.2. The OT pages and controls are unchanged, so the 0.2.1 emulator captures are retained. Current-build hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete runtime memory bounds are not measured for this source and stay waived for this exact version only. Isolated source-only packages, native/browser parity and repository checks remain required.
